title: Anthropic's Own Benchmarks Say the Cheap Model Wins
description:
CursorBench 3.2, Frontier-Bench, ARC-AGI 3, OSWorld and Zapier's automation benchmark. Five charts from Anthropic's own launch post, and the 5 dollar model keeps landing on top of the 10 dollar one.

Half a percent behind at max effort, 3 times the next best on ARC-AGI 3, a third of the cost on OSWorld.

Full walkthrough in the video linked below.

#shorts #claudeopus5 #aibenchmarks
